content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Also could use carbon NMR to count carbonyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool (expensive) but okay. Maybe cheaper to use IR first: carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1. Use ir_spectra. Then interpret. Let's get IR.
